r.notes: This is the first time I’ve looked here for a koala, potentially had a Joey but hard to tell from photos. Tree is on the edge of building zone for new shopping centre

It was in the middle of the road and it went under my car. I heard a bump and a squeal. I saw it was limping off to the side of the road in my rear view mirror. I pulled over with my hazards, but it had gone up a tree before I could get to it. I couldn’t see any blood where it crossed the footpath.
Maybe a young in pouch but could not see. Koala looked reasonably healthy.
First sighting of koala in this small bush patch backing onto my backyard. Very happy!
Koala was crossing the road

Have noted a tree close to walking path with koala markings on trunk. Today discovered this one was on the ground moving easily. When it spotted me it climbed tree as in picture. Looked well and moved easily. Stayed low in tree while I observed it.
